Text describes the Hepu-Bobai branch running from the Sinopec Beihai LNG export trunk line's Baisha valve room to the Bobai distribution station at design pressure 6.3-10 MPa, and the Pubei branch onward at 6.3 MPa, feeding four stations (3 new distribution stations + 1 upgraded distribution station) -- i.e. a high-pressure branch line carrying gas from a trunk/import pipeline to city-gate distribution stations, the standard profile for 'transmission' rather than local low-pressure 'distribution' mains. Searched extensively (Chinese: '合浦-博白-浦北' + 2023年4月, 核准, 立项) for a document dating a ProposalYear/Month=2023-04 milestone for this project and found none. Instead found two dated approvals for this exact project, both well before 2023-04: the Guangxi DRC core approval (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn/zfxxgkzl/wjzx/xmpf/xiangmuhezhunpifu/t5575253.shtml, referenced in the wiki's own citation #29) dated 2020-06-17, and the EIA approval 桂环审〔2020〕323号 dated 2020-09-08 (confirmed via archived snapshot, see Fuel/PipelineType). A proposal date should precede or coincide with formal core approval, not postdate it by ~3 years, so 2023-04 looks mis-keyed. This is a value disagreement, not a citation gap -- not proposing a ref that would 'support' 2023-04 when the best evidence contradicts it; routes to Update to re-derive ProposalYear/Month from the 2020-06-17 DRC approval. (Matches the concern already logged in rows/P4728.json validity[2].)

Partial disagreement, not a clean support -- can't cite. The EIA approval text (same doc as Length/Diameter) is explicit: the Hepu-Bobai branch '起自中石化北海LNG外输管道白沙阀室' (starts at the Baisha valve room of the Sinopec Beihai LNG export pipeline, i.e. in Hepu County/Beihai City) '止于博白支线博白分输站' (ends at the Bobai branch's Bobai distribution station, Bobai County/Yulin City); the Pubei branch then continues on to Pubei County/Qinzhou City. So EndLocation='Pubei County'/EndPrefecture='Qinzhou' (recorded) IS confirmed. But recorded StartLocation='Bobai County'/StartPrefecture='Yulin' is NOT -- the true start point is Hepu County (Beihai City) at the Baisha valve room; 'Bobai County' is actually the MIDPOINT/end of the first branch, not the start, and Hepu/Beihai is omitted from the record entirely. This exact attribution error was already flagged in rows/P4728.json validity[1]. Per standing rule, not proposing a ref that would 'support' a StartLocation the best evidence contradicts; routes to Update to correct StartLocation/StartPrefecture to Hepu County/Beihai.

CAVEAT worth a human spot-check: the EIA approval's addressee/permit-holder line reads '广西广投天然气管道有限公司' (Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas PIPELINE Co Ltd) -- one character off from the recorded QCCOwner(业主单位)='广西广投天然气管网有限公司' (...PIPELINE NETWORK Co Ltd, i.e. 管道 vs 管网). Searched company registries (search results auto-normalize to 管网, no separate '管道'-named entity surfaces on qcc/tianyancha-indexed results) -- couldn't find evidence of two distinct companies, so I read this as a naming inconsistency in one document referring to the same real entity, not a different company; proposing the ref but flagging the character variant rather than treating it as a clean match. Verified OK on '广投'. Second, independent source: shpgx.com company-news article (2024-01-04, '广投管网公司连续安全生产4000天纪实') confirms '广西广投天然气管网有限公司' (exact spelling match) is the real, active entity that builds/operates Guangxi's provincial gas branch-pipeline network (est. 2011, Guangxi Investment Group subsidiary) -- consistent with this segment being one of that network's branch lines, though this second source doesn't name the Hepu-Bobai-Pubei segment specifically. Two independent sources but with the name-variant caveat on the primary one -- tier=medium not high.
